DIESEL_REFINING_CRISIS.label: Diesel / refining crisis
DIESEL_REFINING_CRISIS.summary: All provided candidates are LEAD-phase signals about refinery maintenance and capacity constraints, indicating potential refining bottlenecks. No CONFIRM or LAG evidence regarding Brent stability or diesel/jet premiums is present.
